description: Source code for ParserSurfaceFlinger class, which extends AbstractParser to parse SurfaceFlinger trace files in an Android project.

classes.name: ParserSurfaceFlinger
classes.description: A parser class for SurfaceFlinger trace files, extending AbstractParser to decode and process trace data.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type, specifically TraceType.SURFACE_FLINGER.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Returns the magic number array identifying the trace file format.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Decodes a buffer into trace entries, handling the realToElapsedTimeOffsetNs property.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a Timestamp object based on the entry proto and timestamp type.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Processes a decoded trace entry proto into a LayerTraceEntry object.
